notes: Component only: fullModelQualified, gainQualified, installable, productionPerformanceClaim and busyTimeClaim are always false; no default, kernel, guard or artifact changes.

Control is the production g4_q4_matvec from Gemma4Runner.shaderSource compiled with options nil; candidates are compiled with options nil. Identical source does not guarantee identical compiled bits; bit identity is measured on every row of every case.

Correctness gates per case and variant: finite outputs, existing 1e-4 FP64 contract for control and candidate (a control failure is retained), Float bit identity candidate versus control, intact 256-byte guards, and a pre-dispatch decline for the predeclared unsupported odd-block shape.

Timing (only after a variant passes every case): per shape 2 warmup pairs then 6 timed pairs in alternating execution order. Each pair runs its two arms in TWO sequential command buffers, each with one sampled serial single-dispatch encoder; the second is encoded and committed only after the first was observed terminal, so the stage intervals cannot overlap (dispatchType .serial orders dispatches within one encoder, not independent encoders). Samples 0/1 then 2/3 are resolved twice after both are terminal; raw ticks, a raw ratio and per-order ratios only. The second arm reads weights the first just read, so an order effect is reported, not removed.
Real tensor rows are bounded reads of the local GGUF file; no weight is hashed, serialized or uploaded anywhere but the local GPU buffer of this process.

Motivation is not measurement: phase 59 found 3221 of 125457 adjacent encoder ranges overlapping, so its raw family medians cannot be summed into GPU shares, and per-encoder fixed-overhead dominance of small families is a hypothesis. This component's raw ratio is a single-kernel stage-tick comparison and implies no full-model gain.
timestampUnits: raw GPU timestamp ticks as resolved at stage boundaries; the installed SDK declarations state no unit; nothing is converted; intervals are not busy time
